paper: DESI Collaboration, DESI 2024 VI: cosmological constraints from BAO, JCAP 02(2025)021, arXiv:2404.03002 (PDF sha256 8e603ac88d861803cbd0004a6a4717934f7252fd057257fd6fa1ceb4b487cd36, 71 pages, built 2024-11-04)
frozen_before: any likelihood, distance or posterior has been computed from the BAO data. At freeze time only the PDF text and the file names of CobayaSampler/bao_data have been looked at.

data.check_before_use: the 12 means and the diagonal errors must round to Table 1 of the paper (page 10) at its printed precision, and the DM/DH correlations must round to the r column. If not, stop and report; no other file is substituted silently.

model.cosmology: flat LCDM, Omega_K = 0, Omega_Lambda = 1 - Omega_m - Omega_r (CAMB)
model.neutrinos: one massive neutrino, sum m_nu = 0.06 eV, N_eff = 3.044 (CAMB: mnu=0.06, num_massive_neutrinos=1, nnu=3.044). Omega_m includes the massive neutrino (Table 2 caption): omch2 = Omega_m h^2 - ombh2 - omnuh2
model.distances: D_M(z) and H(z) from CAMB background; D_H = c/H, D_V = (z D_M^2 D_H)^(1/3), c = 299792.458 km/s
model.bao_only_h: BAO-only depends on (Omega_m, r_d h) only, up to the radiation term. We fix h = 0.68 and ombh2 = 0.02218 for the CAMB background in the BAO-only case, and define r_d h = h * r_d with r_d = (r_d h)/h. Sensitivity check (does not change verdict): h = 0.60 and 0.76.

likelihood: Gaussian, chi2 = (d - m)^T C^-1 (d - m) with the 12-point mean vector and 12x12 covariance above, m = model D_V/r_d, D_M/r_d, D_H/r_d at each z_eff as labelled in the mean file

bao_bbn.ombh2: U[0.005, 0.1] times Gaussian N(0.02218, 0.00055) (Eq. 2.8, LCDM BBN prior, Schoeneberg 2024)

inference.bao_only: deterministic grid. Omega_m on a uniform grid over [0.15, 0.50] (prior mass outside is negligible, checked by the posterior at the edges being < 1e-8 of the peak), r_d h analytic on a fine grid over [90, 115] Mpc, same edge check. CAMB is called once per Omega_m node.
inference.bao_bbn: emcee ensemble sampler over (Omega_m, H0, ombh2) calling CAMB at every point (no interpolation). Convergence: chain length > 50 integrated autocorrelation times for every parameter and ESS > 10^4 after burn-in (paper asks for ESS >~ 10^3 and R-1 < 0.01).
inference.reporting: marginal posterior mean and standard deviation (paper Sec 2.5: symmetric 1D posteriors are reported as mean and std of the samples)

claims.text: DESI BAO alone, flat LCDM: Omega_m = 0.295 +/- 0.015
claims.where: Eq. 4.1, page 21; also Table 3 row DESI
claims.reasoning: mean: 0.2 x published sd (0.003) for Monte Carlo noise in the published chains plus implementation differences (CAMB version, our fixed h), plus half of the last printed digit (0.0005). sd: +/-10% around the printed interval [0.0145, 0.0155). A wrong prior range, a missing data point or a dropped correlation would move these well outside.

claims.text: DESI BAO alone, flat LCDM: r_d h = (101.8 +/- 1.3) Mpc
claims.reasoning: mean: 0.2 x 1.3 = 0.26 plus half digit 0.05. sd: +/-10% around [1.25, 1.35).

claims.text: DESI BAO + BBN, flat LCDM: H0 = (68.53 +/- 0.80) km/s/Mpc
claims.reasoning: mean: 0.2 x 0.80 = 0.16 plus half digit 0.005. sd: +/-10% around [0.795, 0.805). Using a much tighter BBN prior (e.g. 0.00015 width) or omitting the neutrino mass should show up as an sd or mean outside this band.

verdict_rule: Reproduced if all three claims have mean and sd inside their band. Partially if one or two do. Not reproduced if none does. A claim that could not be computed is 'not tested'.
extra_not_verdict: cobaya cross-check with its bundled DESI 2024 likelihood, if it installs without accepting any terms
h sensitivity of the BAO-only result
DESI public chains (data.desi.lbl.gov) only as a labelled diagnostic after our numbers exist, if reachable without login
